name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MoMSME)
description: Credit-linked subsidy programme to generate self-employment opportunities through establishment of micro-enterprises in non-farm sector.
subsidy_percentage: 15% to 35% (Higher for rural & special categories like SC/ST/OBC/Women)
required_documents: Educational Qualification Certificate (8th pass for project > ₹10L in mfg)
Rural Area Certificate (if claiming rural 35% subsidy)
EDP Training Certificate (online/offline prior to 1st loan release)
eligibility_criteria: Any individual above 18 years of age
For project above ₹10 Lakh in manufacturing sector and above ₹5 Lakh in service sector, minimum qualification is 8th standard pass
Only new projects are eligible under PMEGP
Self Help Groups (SHGs) not availing benefits under other schemes are also eligible
application_steps: Register and submit online application on PMEGP e-Portal (kviconline.gov.in)
Upload required documents (Aadhaar, Caste certificate, Photo, DPR)
District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC) scrutinizes the application
Application is forwarded to chosen Financing Bank for sanction
Complete mandatory 5-10 days Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP) training
Bank releases loan and KVIC deposits Government Margin Money subsidy in TDR account
verification_disclaimer: Verify current guidelines and portal links on official MoMSME/KVIC portals.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Finance (Department of Financial Services)
description: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one SC or ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise.
funding_type: Composite Bank Loan (Term Loan + Working Capital)
subsidy_percentage: Margin money reduced up to 15% (can converge with state subsidies)
required_documents: Proof of Identity (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Passport)
Project Report with projected cash flows
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be an SC/ST and/or woman entrepreneur above 18 years of age
Loan is available only for greenfield (first time) enterprises in manufacturing, services, agri-allied, or trading sectors
In case of non-individual enterprises, at least 51% shareholding and controlling stake must be held by SC/ST or Women
Borrower should not be in default to any bank/financial institution
application_steps: Visit the Stand-Up India portal (standupmitra.in)
Register as a borrower and select handholding support if required
Fill the loan application and upload project feasibility report
Application is directed to the chosen Scheduled Commercial Bank
Bank assesses loan feasibility and sanctions credit facility
verification_disclaimer: Verify current eligibility and margin requirements on the official Stand-Up Mitra portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana — Shishu
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: Provides micro-credit up to ₹50,000 to budding micro-entrepreneurs, shopkeepers, fruit/vegetable vendors, and rural artisans with zero collateral.
subsidy_percentage: Nil upfront subsidy (Low interest, Zero collateral & processing fees waived)
required_documents: Quotation of machinery/items to be purchased (if applicable)
eligibility_criteria: Any Indian citizen with a business plan for non-farm income generating activity
Credit requirement up to ₹50,000
No past default history with any financial institution
application_steps: Apply through Udyamimitra portal or visit any public/private sector bank or MFI branch
Submit Shishu loan application form with KYC and price quotes
Instant sanction and disbursement to Mudra Card/Account upon verification
verification_disclaimer: Verify current processing terms with your designated lending bank.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana — Kishore
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: Funding support from ₹50,001 up to ₹5,00,000 for mid-stage micro-enterprises looking to purchase equipment, raw material, or expand operations.
subsidy_percentage: Collateral-free backed by Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units (CGFMU)
required_documents: Proof of Category (SC/ST/OBC Certificate if applicable)
Sales tax / GST returns (for existing units over threshold)
Quotation for machinery or expansion estimate
eligibility_criteria: Small business owners, artisans, service providers needing ₹50,001 to ₹5 Lakhs
Satisfactory credit record without non-performing assets
Viable business model demonstrating repayment capacity
application_steps: Apply online via JanSamarth portal or UdyamiMitra
Upload KYC, Udyam registration, and quotation documents
Lending institution reviews cash flows and sanctions loan
Funds disbursed directly for machinery purchase and working capital limit
verification_disclaimer: Verify interest rates and processing requirements on the official MUDRA/JanSamarth portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana — Tarun
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: Provides loans from ₹5,00,001 to ₹10,00,000 (extended up to ₹20 Lakhs in recent policy for proven repeat borrowers) for enterprise scaling.
subsidy_percentage: Covered under national credit guarantee scheme
required_documents: Audited balance sheets for previous 2 years
Partnership deed / Memorandum of Association (if registered entity)
eligibility_criteria: Established micro-units with operating track record seeking growth capital
Funding requirement between ₹5 Lakh and ₹10 Lakh
Clean financial repayment history
application_steps: Submit proposal on JanSamarth portal (jansamarth.in)
Select partner bank and submit historical financials
In-principle approval issued online followed by branch verification
verification_disclaimer: Verify recent credit limit enhancements on official portal.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Special micro-credit facility providing affordable working capital loans to urban and peri-urban street vendors to resume livelihoods.
subsidy_percentage: 7% interest subsidy credited directly to bank account + digital cashback up to ₹1,200/year
required_documents: Vending Certificate / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Body (ULB)
Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from ULB/Town Vending Committee (if ID card missing)
Bank account details linked with Aadhaar
eligibility_criteria: Street vendors engaged in vending in urban/peri-urban areas on or before the qualifying cut-off date
Tranche 1: ₹10,000 (repayable in 1 year)
Tranche 2: ₹20,000 upon timely repayment of 1st loan
Tranche 3: ₹50,000 upon timely repayment of 2nd loan
application_steps: Access PMSVANidhi portal or mobile app (pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in)
Verify Aadhaar with OTP
Upload Certificate of Vending or LoR
Select Preferred Lending Institution (Lender)
Disbursement credited directly to bank account
verification_disclaimer: Verify latest interest subsidy cycles on the official PM SVANidhi portal.

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: Holistic support scheme providing recognition, skill upgradation, ₹15,000 toolkit incentive, and collateral-free enterprise credit at 5% concessional interest to traditional artisans and craftspeople.
funding_type: Skill Stipend + Toolkit Grant (₹15,000) + Concessional Credit (up to ₹3 Lakh)
subsidy_percentage: 5% subsidized interest rate (MoMSME pays up to 8% subvention) + ₹15k grant for modern tools
required_documents: Declaration of engagement in one of 18 designated traditional trades (Carpenter, Blacksmith, Potter, Weaver, Cobbler, Tailor, etc.)
eligibility_criteria: Artisan working with hands and tools in one of the 18 specified family-based traditional trades
Minimum age 18 years on the date of registration
Beneficiary should not have availed loans under PMEGP/Mudra/PM-SVANidhi in last 5 years
Registration limited to one member per family
application_steps: Register via Common Service Centre (CSC) on pmvishwakarma.gov.in
Three-step verification: Gram Panchayat/ULB, District Implementation Committee, Screening Committee
Receive PM Vishwakarma Certificate & Digital ID
Complete 5-7 days basic skill training with ₹500/day stipend
Receive ₹15,000 electronic voucher for toolkit purchase
Avail Tranche 1 credit (up to ₹1 Lakh @ 5%) and Tranche 2 (up to ₹2 Lakh)
verification_disclaimer: Verify list of 18 trades and CSC center enrollment on the official PM Vishwakarma portal.

name: PM Formalisation of Micro food processing Enterprises (PM-FME)
ministry: Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI)
description: Centrally sponsored scheme to enhance competitiveness of individual micro-enterprises in the food processing industry and promote formalization of the sector.
subsidy_percentage: 35% of eligible project cost with a ceiling of ₹10 Lakh per unit
required_documents: Proof of ownership or lease of premises
eligibility_criteria: Existing micro food processing unit or prospective entrepreneur entering the food processing sector
Unit must follow the One District One Product (ODOP) focus of the district for priority assistance
Individual micro-units should contribute at least 10% of project cost as margin money
Ownership status: Sole proprietorship, partnership, FPO, or SHG
application_steps: Register on the PMFME portal (pmfme.mofpi.gov.in)
Submit Detailed Project Report (DPR) with machinery quotations
District Resource Person (DRP) assists in document preparation and verification
District Level Committee recommends loan to the lending bank
Bank disburses loan and capital subsidy is transferred to subsidy reserve fund
verification_disclaimer: Check your district's One District One Product (ODOP) list on official portal.

name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Micro & Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
ministry: Ministry of MSME & SIDBI
description: Enables collateral-free credit (term loans and working capital) up to ₹5 Crore to micro and small enterprises by guaranteeing bank credit risk.
subsidy_percentage: Guarantee coverage up to 85% for Women/SC/ST/Aspirational Districts
required_documents: Past 2 years audited financial statements (for existing units)
Sanction letter from Member Lending Institution (MLI)
eligibility_criteria: New and existing Micro and Small Enterprises engaged in manufacturing or service activities
Loan facility up to ₹500 Lakhs without third-party guarantee or collateral security
Applicant enterprise must have a valid Udyam Registration
application_steps: Prepare viable project proposal and obtain Udyam Registration
Apply to any Scheduled Bank / NBFC (Member Lending Institution)
Bank evaluates proposal and sanctions loan under CGTMSE cover directly
Borrower pays nominal annual guarantee fee (concessional for women/SC/ST)
verification_disclaimer: Confirm current guarantee fee concessions for special categories on CGTMSE portal.

name: National SC-ST Hub (NSSH) Special Credit Linked Capital Subsidy
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: Provides 25% capital subsidy for procurement of plant and machinery to SC/ST entrepreneurs for technology upgradation and scaling.
subsidy_percentage: 25% upfront capital subsidy on institutional finance up to ₹1 Crore
required_documents: Caste Certificate issued by Competent Authority
Udyam Registration Certificate with SC/ST classification
Bank Loan Sanction Letter for term loan
CA Certificate certifying investment in plant & machinery
eligibility_criteria: Sole Proprietorship units owned by SC/ST entrepreneurs
In partnership/private limited companies, at least 51% stake held by SC/ST promoter(s)
Must have availed institutional credit from eligible lending institutions for machinery
Valid Udyam Registration
application_steps: Obtain institutional term loan sanction for plant & machinery
Register on National SC-ST Hub portal (scsthub.in)
Nodal bank uploads subsidy claim on MSME portal
Subsidy disbursed directly to loan account upon verification
verification_disclaimer: Verify eligible machinery categories with National SC/ST Hub Nodal Office.

name: Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Supports commercial ventures and innovative tech ideas promoted by SC youth and students through Technology Business Incubators (TBIs).
subsidy_percentage: Up to ₹30 Lakh equity funding over 3 years (₹10 Lakh per year)
required_documents: Incubation Recommendation letter from certified TBI / DST incubator
eligibility_criteria: SC youth/innovators identified by Technology Business Incubators (TBIs)
Entities where SC promoters hold at least 51% equity
Innovative, tech-oriented business ideas with commercial potential
Age below 40 years
application_steps: Connect with a partner TBI or apply via Venture Capital Fund for SC (VCF-SC) portal
Submit innovation pitch deck and prototype demonstration
Screening by ASIIM Investment Committee
Fund disbursement in milestones linked with incubation progress
verification_disclaimer: Check accredited TBIs and incubator list on VCF-SC/ASIIM portal.

name: Mahila Samridhi Yojana (NBCFDC)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Micro-finance scheme providing concessional loans through State Channelising Agencies (SCAs) to women entrepreneurs belonging to Backward Classes.
subsidy_percentage: Extremely low interest rate of 4% per annum (NBCFDC to SCA @ 1%)
required_documents: OBC / Backward Class Certificate issued by State authority
Self-Help Group (SHG) membership card (if applying through group)
eligibility_criteria: Women entrepreneurs belonging to Backward Classes as notified by Central/State govt
Annual family income must be below ₹3 Lakh
Individual borrower or member of women SHG
No default with local cooperative or regional bank
application_steps: Contact State Channelising Agency (SCA) or Regional Rural Bank (RRB)
Fill Mahila Samridhi application form with OBC and income certificate
SCA processes application under NBCFDC credit line
Loan disbursed at 4% annual interest with flexible quarterly repayments
verification_disclaimer: Verify state channelising agency contacts on official NBCFDC portal.

name: NMDFC Term Loan Scheme for Minority Entrepreneurs
ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs
description: Concessional term loans up to ₹20 Lakhs for commercially viable and self-employment ventures by entrepreneurs from notified minority communities.
subsidy_percentage: Interest rate as low as 6% p.a. for Credit Line-1 and 8% p.a. for Credit Line-2
required_documents: Minority Community Certificate / Self-declaration affidavit (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi)
eligibility_criteria: Member of notified minority community
Credit Line 1: Annual family income up to ₹98,000 (rural) / ₹1,20,000 (urban)
Credit Line 2: Annual family income up to ₹8,00,000
Age between 18 and 65 years
application_steps: Apply through State Channelising Agency (SCA) of State Minority Development Corporation
Submit KYC, minority verification, and project proposal
SCA sanctions loan with repayment tenure up to 5 years
verification_disclaimer: Check state minority corporation portal for current intake dates.

name: Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries (SFURTI)
ministry: Ministry of MSME
description: Organizes traditional artisans and rural craft producers into viable competitive clusters with modern machinery, common facility centres, and market linkage.
subsidy_percentage: Up to 90% grant (up to ₹2.5 Cr for regular / ₹5 Cr for major cluster)
required_documents: Detailed Diagnostic Study & Detailed Project Report (DPR)
Consent for land/building for Common Facility Centre (CFC)
eligibility_criteria: Artisan groups, SHGs, Cooperatives, NGOs, or Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs)
Cluster must represent traditional sectors like Khadi, Coir, Bamboo, Honey, Handlooms, or Handicrafts
Promotes collective ownership and common infrastructure
application_steps: Nodal Agency (KVIC/Coir Board) invites cluster proposals
Technical Agency conducts Diagnostic Study and prepares DPR
Scheme Steering Committee approves project and releases grant in phases
verification_disclaimer: Verify list of empaneled Technical Agencies on SFURTI portal.

name: Agri-Clinics and Agri-Business Centres Scheme (ACABC)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (MANAGE)
description: Subsidized bank loan scheme to enable agricultural graduates, diploma holders, and rural science entrepreneurs to set up custom hiring, inputs, and advisory enterprises.
subsidy_percentage: 36% capital subsidy (enhanced to 44% for Women, SC/ST, and Hill/NE States)
required_documents: Agriculture / Allied Science Degree / Diploma Certificate
Detailed Project Report for agribusiness unit
eligibility_criteria: Graduates in Agriculture and allied subjects (Horticulture, Dairy, Veterinary, Fisheries, Agronomy)
Diploma holders in Agriculture subjects with at least 50% marks
Completion of MANAGE certified residential training program
Ceiling of project cost: ₹20 Lakh for individual, ₹1 Crore for group of 5
application_steps: Apply online for 45-day training program at manage.gov.in
Complete free training with residential boarding provided by MANAGE
Prepare DPR with mentor support
Submit DPR to commercial bank for loan sanction
NABARD credits composite subsidy to borrower's account upon sanction
verification_disclaimer: Verify upcoming MANAGE training batches on official ACABC website.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
description: Flagship scheme to boost fisheries production, cold storage, hatcheries, fish retail kiosks, and ornamental fisheries with high subsidies for marginalized groups.
subsidy_percentage: 40% subsidy for General; 60% for SC, ST, and Women beneficiaries
required_documents: Proof of Land / Water Body ownership or Registered Lease for minimum 7-10 years
Detailed estimate/DPR for fish pond, biofloc, or retail kiosk
eligibility_criteria: Fishers, Fish Farmers, Fisheries Development Corporations, SHGs, and Micro-entrepreneurs
Possession of suitable land/water resources or leased premises
Beneficiary must bear minimum 40% margin (for SC/ST/Women) or 60% (for General)
application_steps: Apply through State Department of Fisheries or online on pmmsy.dof.gov.in
District Fisheries Development Officer verifies site inspection
District Level Committee forwards approved DPR to State Level Committee
Sanction letter issued; financial subsidy released in project progress milestones
verification_disclaimer: Verify current district target allocations with your local District Fisheries Officer.

name: Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes (VCF-SC)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (IFCI Venture)
description: First-of-its-kind venture capital fund providing concessional equity and debt funding to high-growth, technology, manufacturing, and scalable ventures promoted by SC entrepreneurs.
subsidy_percentage: Concessional coupon rate of 4% p.a. (for SC women/disabled) / 8% p.a. (others)
required_documents: SC Caste Certificate of key promoters
Company Incorporation documents (Private Limited / Public Limited)
Proof of minimum 51% shareholding by SC promoters for 12 months
Audited financial statements and Business Plan
Due diligence technical and financial reports
eligibility_criteria: Company registered under Companies Act with at least 51% SC shareholding and management control
Viable business concept with demonstrable scalability and commercial return
Credit assistance ranges from ₹20 Lakhs to ₹15 Crores
application_steps: Submit detailed application on vcfsc.in portal
Preliminary evaluation by IFCI Venture Capital team
Presentation before Investment Committee
Due diligence, term sheet agreement, and disbursement in tranches
verification_disclaimer: Review formal term sheet rules and IFCI Venture guidelines on official portal.

name: Coir Vikas Yojana — Science & Technology / Skill Upgradation
ministry: Ministry of MSME (Coir Board)
description: Assistance for procurement of modern machinery, technology induction, and skill training for traditional coir workers, women self-help groups, and rural cottage units.
subsidy_percentage: 25% to 50% subsidy on modern coir spinning/weaving machinery
required_documents: Proof of Training in Coir Craft
Proforma Invoice of machinery from authorized manufacturer
eligibility_criteria: Coir artisans, spinning units, and rural women coir cooperatives
Willingness to modernize conventional ratts with motorized spinning machines
Availability of coconut husk/coir raw material in local area
application_steps: Submit application to nearest Coir Board Sub-Regional Office or portal
Physical verification by field officer
Sanction issued and subsidy disbursed directly to machine supplier or unit account
verification_disclaimer: Consult local Coir Board field offices for machinery vendor empaneled list.

name: National Livestock Mission (NLM) & Dairy Infrastructure Development
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
description: Capital subsidy support for establishing modern mini dairy units, milking machines, bulk milk cooling units, and value-added dairy product manufacturing.
subsidy_percentage: 25% for general; 33.33% for SC/ST and women farmers/entrepreneurs
required_documents: Aadhaar Card and Caste certificate (if SC/ST)
Land records (7/12 extract or registered lease)
Detailed project estimate for dairy sheds and cattle purchase
eligibility_criteria: Farmers, individual entrepreneurs, NGOs, Companies, and SHGs
Applicant can set up small dairy unit (2 to 10 crossbred cows/buffaloes) or milk processing unit
Must secure minimum 10% own promoter contribution
application_steps: Submit project proposal to commercial bank, RRB, or State Cooperative Bank
Bank sanctions credit and forwards subsidy request to NABARD
NABARD releases subsidy into Subsidy Reserve Fund account
verification_disclaimer: Check current fiscal year allocation under NLM portal.

name: ASPIRE (Scheme for Promotion of Innovation, Rural Industry & Entrepreneurship)
ministry: Ministry of MSME
description: Sets up Livelihood Business Incubators (LBIs) and Technology Business Incubators (TBIs) to generate employment in agro-rural industries and empower youth with marketable trade skills.
subsidy_percentage: 100% grant for machinery at LBIs + Seed capital up to ₹1 Crore through SIDBI fund of funds
eligibility_criteria: Rural youth and micro-entrepreneurs trained in Livelihood Business Incubators
Focus on agro-processing, local bio-resources, rural manufacturing, and farm tech
Aspiring to establish micro-enterprises with local raw materials
application_steps: Enroll in nearby MSME Livelihood Business Incubator (LBI)
Undergo hands-on prototype and machinery operation training
Submit enterprise proposal for seed capital assistance through MSME-SIDBI fund
verification_disclaimer: Verify nearest functional LBI at official MSME ASPIRE directory.
